title: Financial insights
headline: Overdue receivables are 1,900 of 12,500. Payables overdue are 1,300 of 8,400, and the month still covers its costs.

receivables.note: Most of the book is current. 1,700 sits at 30 days.

payables.note: The overdue piece is the 30-day bucket.

current_month: Revenue for the month is 86,700 and expenses are 78,940.
trends: Revenue has climbed from July through November, then eased in December.
Expenses stayed below revenue in every month of the half year.
actions: Chase the 30-day receivable before the January close.
Keep the 30-day payable on the next payment run.
